## RangeLink32 v1.0.3

Final software hardening release candidate before ESP32U hardware validation.

### Reliability and safety fixes

- Hardened local Wi-Fi QR generation for maximum valid SSID/password lengths, including worst-case escaping.
- Fixed the 24-device history saturation edge case: when persistent client history is full, unknown/no-slot clients now fail closed instead of inheriting AllowAll forwarding and bypassing per-device accounting.
- Added strict quota and speed parsing with finite production bounds:
  - daily quota: up to 1 TB,
  - monthly quota: up to 32 TB,
  - speed cap: up to 1000 Mbps.
- Invalid, malformed and overflow-style numeric submissions are rejected.
- Device-limit persistence failures are now surfaced to the admin UI.
- Propagated NVS write failures through normal save paths for hotspot/admin credentials, first-boot credentials, saved Wi-Fi profiles, client policies, access mode, timezone, DNS, profile priority and usage updates.
- Credential updates now perform best-effort rollback and enter secure recovery if rollback cannot be completed.
- Client/admin mutation routes no longer report success when persistence fails.

### Tests

- Added host tests for strict decimal parsing and malformed/overflow-style input rejection.
- Existing policy, quota, schedule, credential and failover logic tests remain enabled.
- Full ESP32 firmware build and the 90% flash safety budget remain enforced in GitHub Actions.

### Hardware validation still required

This release is software-final, not hardware-validated. Complete the ESP32U hardware checklist before calling the project production/hardware validated, including NAPT forwarding, OTA boot, Wi-Fi driver behavior, external antenna/range and soak testing.
